jd_keywords: Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book

summary: Global Treasury Audit, Vice President candidate with ~7 years across Asset Liability Management, Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book, and independent model review. Holds delegated sign-off authority at Moody's Analytics on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement, and serves on the model governance committee. Depth in NII and EVE sensitivity, behavioral cash flow assumptions, stress testing, hedging, and senior management reporting. CFA charterholder; dual MSc.
core_skills: Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book (IRRBB)
Net Interest Income (NII) & Economic Value of Equity (EVE) Sensitivity
Interest Rate, Inflation & FX Hedging Analysis

sections.heading: Interest Rate Risk Measurement, Assumptions & Scenario Design
bullets: Oversaw interest-rate risk, duration, and convexity analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks — the EVE and NII sensitivity mechanics underlying IRRBB standards consistent with Basel Committee and industry supervisory frameworks.

Embedded and validated behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays within projection models, aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations and executive contingency planning.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.

sections.heading: Balance Sheet, Funding & Liquidity Analysis
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.
Reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.

sections.heading: Independent Challenge, Governance & Management Reporting
bullets: Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Served on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment consistent with SR 11-7-style model risk expectations.
Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and acted as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into committee-ready conclusions.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms on the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms, validating model outputs post-deployment.

Advised clients on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and translated investment-team requirements into development requests, completing migration of all assigned accounts from the legacy Calypso platform.
Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes, coordinating actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management functions on milestone delivery.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.

Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis covering duration alignment, return objectives, and liquidity, plus interest-rate, inflation, and currency hedging analysis for international clients.
Presented ALM study findings and stress-test results on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
